description: Engine Contract v1 envelope. Every engine command writes exactly one payload of this shape to stdout; human-readable text only goes to stderr. The data member is refined per command by the domain schemas. Exit code semantics: 0 = ok (warnings allowed), 1 = errors non-empty, 2 = contract/usage error.

contract.description: Contract identifier; constant 'agent-manager/engine/v1' for this contract version.

run_id.description: Unique id of this engine run, e.g. '20260905T103000Z-a1b2c3'.

command.description: Command that produced this envelope, e.g. 'mcp.apply' or 'system.audit'.

mode.description: Runtime mode flags interpreted uniformly by the native engine.

offline.description: true when the run must not touch the network.

held.description: true while this run holds the engine lock.

pid.description: Process id of the lock holder, or null when no lock is held.

ok.description: true iff 'errors' is empty; warnings do not flip ok.

data.description: Command payload. Its concrete shape is defined per command by the domain schemas; the envelope only requires an object.

warnings.description: Non-fatal diagnostics, e.g. optional tooling not ready or managed artifacts not yet generated.

errors.description: Fatal diagnostics; non-empty implies exit code 1.

diagnostic.description: One warning or error entry. 'element' carries the element id the entry concerns, or null for run-level diagnostics.

element.description: Element id such as 'mcp:example-search', or null when the entry is not tied to one element.
